en: Multi‑view color postcard showing Turkish art monuments in the city of Pécs, Hungary. The front side is divided into several photographs: a 16th‑century mosque with a tall minaret, an ornate interior mihrab or prayer niche, a small round stone türbe (grave chapel) with a red tiled roof in a green setting, excavated stone ruins and historic houses along a street, and a broader cityscape of Pécs with a central former mosque topped by a large dome in a town square and hills in the background. The reverse side has multilingual descriptive text (Hungarian, German, English, Russian), standard postcard address lines, stamp boxes, a publisher credit from Budapest, and the printed price.
